payload.reason: The evidence provides detailed information about the current state-of-the-art models and their performance on the WSJ dataset, including specific architectures and Word Error Rates (WER).

claims.text: The current best model on WSJ is an HMM-based system that combines convolutional, recurrent, and fully connected layers, achieving the lowest WER.
A fully convolutional model trained end-to-end shows state-of-the-art performance on WSJ, matching the best existing systems.
Replacing the n-gram language model with a convolutional one improves WER, making the model competitive with the best end-to-end systems.
